svg.aria-label: 03. WolfDrivers. Ran in production. The platform a delivery business ran on: a web app for dispatch, a mobile app for drivers, managers and stores, and an AI phone agent that took customer orders. Role: Software engineer. Built: Dispatch web app, mobile app, AI phone ordering, automations. Stack: React, React Native (Expo), Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL.
